entry.title: URMDet-SimFire: Trustworthy multimodal detection with uncertainty and reliability modeling for fire and smoke analytics
entry.summary: A trustworthy multimodal fire-and-smoke detector that models uncertainty and reliability of each modality.

entry.title: DUET: Unified Dual-Space Emotion Control for Diffusion and Flow-Matching Driven Text-to-Speech
entry.summary: DUET adds fine-grained, plug-and-play emotion control to pretrained diffusion and flow-matching TTS models by steering a linearly decodable emotion direction in hidden space and guiding the mel output through a differentiable vocoder, with no retraining.

entry.title: PhysioSER: Learning Physiology-Informed Vocal Spectrotemporal Representations for Speech Emotion Recognition
entry.summary: PhysioSER couples vocal amplitude and phase through voice anatomy and physiology (VAP) informed quaternion representations, aligned with a frozen self-supervised backbone, giving an interpretable and efficient plug-and-play speech emotion recognizer validated on 14 datasets and 10 languages.

entry.title: DSTCN: Exploiting dynamic spatio-temporal correlations for origin-destination demand prediction
entry.summary: DSTCN (Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Correlation Network) forecasts origin-destination demand with three modules: Glstm2D for bidirectional origin/destination demand trends, Simformer for Transformer-based inter-regional similarity over the OD matrix, and FF-TM for temporal fusion; it beats state-of-the-art baselines on NYC-TOD2018, NYC-TOD2019, and HZMetro.

entry.title: S2CMEN: A Mutually Enhancement Network for Superpixel Segmentation and Classification of Hyperspectral Image
entry.summary: A network in which superpixel segmentation and hyperspectral classification reinforce each other, so segmentation boundaries and class predictions improve jointly.

entry.title: BiST-IF: Enhancing origin–destination flow prediction via bi-directional spatio-temporal inference and interconnected feature evolution
entry.summary: BiST-IF predicts metro and taxi origin-destination flows by correcting delayed OD matrices, applying bi-directional origin/destination attention, and letting OD and arrival (Out-OD) flows evolve jointly through mutual-information attention.

entry.title: MR-UFP: Enhancing urban flow prediction via mutual reinforcement with multi-scale regional information
entry.summary: MR-UFP improves urban flow prediction on small or noisy data by pre-training with spatial-temporal masking and contrastive learning, then jointly training the predictor with a multi-scale region-classification task that mutually reinforces spatial features.

entry.title: Automatic visual recognition for leaf disease based on enhanced attention mechanism
entry.summary: An enhanced-attention vision model for fast and accurate recognition of tomato leaf diseases, aimed at early disease prevention in agriculture.

entry.title: S3CFSL: Spatial-Spectral–Semantic Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning for Hyperspectral Image Classification
entry.summary: A cross-domain few-shot learner for hyperspectral images that jointly exploits spatial, spectral, and semantic information to classify new scenes from very few labelled samples.

entry.title: ST-CSL: Spatio-temporal fusion and contrastive learning for urban flow prediction
entry.summary: ST-CSL fuses temporal-view and spatial-view contrastive learning so an urban flow predictor captures global periodicity and the hidden flow relationships between functionally similar regions.

entry.title: MCSTL: Mask- and Contrast-Enhanced Spatio-Temporal Learning for Urban Flow Prediction
entry.summary: MCSTL pre-trains an urban flow model with a mask-reconstruction task across space and time and a graph-based contrastive task that weights regions by inter-regional attention, then fine-tunes for flow prediction.
